scenario: Playground 技术招聘电话开场，面试官笑着说「Doing very well. How are you?」你想自然地回敬。
scenario_en: Opening a Playground recruiter call, the interviewer says warmly, "Doing very well. How are you?"
q: 你会怎么回敬这句开场问候？
q_en: How do you return this warm opener?
options: I'm good, honestly this week's been really busy with a lot of interviews and prep, kind of tired but okay, thanks for asking.
I'm doing great, thanks — just grabbed my coffee. How about you?
I am also in good condition. Thank you for your asking.
options_en: I'm good, honestly this week's been really busy with a lot of interviews and prep, kind of tired but okay, thanks for asking.
I'm doing great, thanks — just grabbed my coffee. How about you?
I am also in good condition. Thank you for your asking.
tradeoff: 自然回敬 vs 一字回声：回声省事，代价是开场冷掉、显得你没真在对话。
why: 别只回声一句「good too」。接住→给一个轻细节(coffee)→把球弹回，才像真人对话。
why_en: Don't just echo "good too" — acknowledge, add one light detail, and bounce the question back so it sounds human.
whenOtherWins: 如果对方只是快速走流程、马上要进正题，一句简短的「Good, thanks, you?」也完全够用。
optionMeanings: 一长串近况倒豆子，把简单问候答成了汇报。
她的真实回答：一句 good too，只有回声没细节。
接住+咖啡细节+弹回问题的自然回敬。
语法生硬的翻译腔，good condition / your asking 都不地道。
optionScenarioImpacts: 信息过载，把轻松开场压成尴尬独白。
回声一句就没了，对话瞬间冷场。
温暖又利落，对方感到你在真交流。
生硬像机器人，反而更显紧张。
optionDirectness: 只回声不给细节也不弹回。
接住—细节—弹回三步齐全。
用词不地道，暴露临场紧张。
optionMeanings_en: Dumps a week of updates onto a simple greeting.
Her real reply: a bare 'good too,' echo with no detail.
Acknowledge + coffee detail + bounce it back.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Overload turns a light opener into an awkward monologue.
One echo and it's over — the call goes cold.
Warm and crisp; they feel you're really talking.
optionDirectness_en: Too long and too much info.
Echo only — no detail, no bounce.

scenario: Amazon 招聘流程介绍电话，面试官说「Good morning to you. Happy Tuesday.」你想热情地回敬。
scenario_en: On an Amazon process call, the interviewer says, "Good morning to you. Happy Tuesday."
q: 面对这句「Happy Tuesday」，怎么回最自然？
q_en: What's the most natural way to return "Happy Tuesday"?
options: Happy Tuesday! I'm good — glad it's a short week. How are you?
Happy Tuesday. I'm pretty good. How about you?
Happy Tuesday to you, yeah it's been a busy one, lots going on with interviews and the job search, but I'm hanging in there, how's your week been so far?
Yes, happy Tuesday as well to you. I am fine. And you?
options_en: Happy Tuesday! I'm good — glad it's a short week. How are you?
Happy Tuesday. I'm pretty good. How about you?
Happy Tuesday to you, yeah it's been a busy one, lots going on with interviews and the job search, but I'm hanging in there, how's your week been so far?
Yes, happy Tuesday as well to you. I am fine. And you?
tradeoff: 加细节回敬 vs 原样弹回：弹回省力，代价是热度没接住，寒暄变客套。
why: 别只把节日词原样弹回。回敬节日+一个轻细节(short week)+问回去，才有温度。
why_en: Don't just echo the holiday word back — return the greeting, add one light detail (short week), then ask back.
whenOtherWins: 如果对方语速很快、明显只想寒暄一句就进正题，短一点的「Happy Tuesday, doing well, you?」也够。
optionMeanings: 回敬节日+short week 细节+问回去的自然回敬。
她的真实回答：把节日词原样弹回，没加细节。
把寒暄扯成一大段近况，节奏失控。
「I am fine」翻译腔，客气却生分。
optionScenarioImpacts: 有温度又利落，寒暄立刻活起来。
平回声，礼貌但没建立连接。
独白太长，开场就抢了对方的话。
机械客气，透着紧张和距离感。
optionDirectness: 只弹回节日词，缺细节缺温度。
optionMeanings_en: Returns the greeting, adds short-week detail, asks back.
Her real reply: echoes the holiday word, no detail.
Stretches small talk into a paragraph of updates.
'I am fine' translationese — polite but distant.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Warm and crisp; small talk comes alive.
Flat echo — polite but no connection.
Monologue steals the floor at the open.
optionDirectness_en: Greeting, detail, and bounce all present.
Only the holiday word — no detail, no warmth.
Overload drifts off the small talk.

scenario: Amazon 电话一开场，面试官说「Hi everyone, good morning. How are you doing?」你一紧张只说出半句就卡住了。
scenario_en: At the very start of an Amazon call, the interviewer says, "Hi everyone, good morning. How are you doing?" and you freeze mid-sentence.
q: 想不被打个措手不及、张口就能答，哪句是准备好的开场回敬？
q_en: To not get caught off guard, which is the ready-to-say opener?
options: Good morning. I am doing well. Thank you. How are you doing.
Good morning! I'm doing well, thanks — happy to be here. How are you?
Morning! I'm good, a little nervous honestly since it's early and I've had a lot of calls this week, but I'm excited, how about everyone on your end?
options_en: Good morning. I am doing well. Thank you. How are you doing.
Good morning! I'm doing well, thanks — happy to be here. How are you?
Morning! I'm good, a little nervous honestly since it's early and I've had a lot of calls this week, but I'm excited, how about everyone on your end?
tradeoff: 备好一句 vs 临场硬挤：没背过就容易卡成「I'm pretty…」，背熟了张口即答。
why: 开场问候可以提前背熟——「good morning + doing well + happy to be here + you?」张口就来，就不会卡成半句。
why_en: The opening greeting can be rehearsed cold — "good morning, doing well, happy to be here, and you?" so you never trail off into half a sentence.
whenOtherWins: 如果确实状态不好、也愿意坦诚，一句轻描淡写的「Bit of an early start, but good — you?」比硬装更真实。
optionMeanings: 她的真实反应：话说一半卡住。
逐词翻译腔，连问句都没有语调。
背熟的四段式开场：问候+状态+一句轻松+弹回。
老实交代紧张，还越扯越长。
optionScenarioImpacts: 半句卡住，一开场就失分。
利落温暖，开场稳稳接住。
自曝紧张又拖沓，削弱气场。
optionMeanings_en: Her real reaction: trails off mid-sentence.
Rehearsed four-part open: greet, status, light line, bounce.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Half a sentence stalls — loses the open.
Stiff and mechanical, like reading a script.
Crisp and warm; the open lands steady.
Self-outed nerves plus rambling weaken presence.
